mapper.select: SELECT SUBJECT_ID as subjectId, SUBJECT_CODE as subjectCode, SUBJECT_NAME as subjectName, SUBJECT_LEVEL as subjectLevel, PARENT_SUBJECT_ID as parentSubjectId, SUBJECT_TYPE as subjectType, BALANCE_DIRECTION as balanceDirection, IS_LEAF as isLeaf, IS_ENABLED as isEnabled, IS_CASH as isCash, IS_BANK as isBank, AUXILIARY_TYPES as auxiliaryTypes, BOOK_ID as bookId, TENANT_ID as tenantId, VERSION as version, CREATE_TIME as createTime, UPDATE_TIME as updateTime, CREATOR as creator, UPDATER as updater FROM TBL_ACCOUNT_SUBJECT WHERE IS_DELETED = 0 AND BOOK_ID = #{bookId} AND TENANT_ID = #{tenantId} AND IS_ENABLED = 1 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE ASC
